facts.fact_text: In May 2008, the applicant was informed that a disciplinary investigation had been initiated against him for being absent without leave on 1 May 2008.
The disciplinary sanction of a warning was imposed on the applicant pursuant to section 125 of the Civil Servants Act (Law no. 657).
A full description of the relevant domestic law at the material time can be found in Karaçay v. Turkey (no. 6615/03, §§ 14-17, 27 March 2007).
A full description of the relevant domestic law at the material time can be found in İsmail Sezer v. Turkey (no. 36807/07, §§ 14-21, 24 March 2015).
The applicant was given a warning as a disciplinary sanction owing to his being absent without leave on 1 May 2008.
